$comment: TTS voices for demo videos. Fish Audio only. Add a voice, then point defaults.en / defaults.es at its name. Every voice needs its owner/source and a license that allows use in ads. s2.1-pro-free costs nothing until freeUntil; after that renders need --allow-paid-tts. Fish's terms: free-plan / free-model audio is for personal or test use; audio for published ads must come from a paid plan or paid model (fish.audio/terms, fish.audio/plan). The voices below are Fish Official designed voices (source voice_design), not clones of real people.

kendall.name: Kendall (Fish Official, en-US, female, late 20s, friendly and relaxed)
kendall.license: Fish Official voice_design (synthetic, no real person). s2.1-pro-free output is for review; re-render with a paid model on a paid account before publishing an ad.
